overall_assessment: Track 24 maintains exemplary security and governance boundaries across cryptographic release verification, network policies, and remote protocol limits. Detached Ed25519 release verification enforces length-prefixed domain-separated canonical messages prefixed with 'org.searchright.provider-component-release-signature.message.v1', binding schema version, component ID, version, ABI, manifest digest, component digest, key ID, trust policy ID, signed_at, and expires_at. Key revocations fail closed immediately at or after the revoked_at timestamp. In compliance with Searchright non-negotiable rules, remote unauthenticated HTTP execution is strictly denied: OpenAPI 3.1.0 specifications in searchright-http.openapi.yaml provide candidate endpoint definitions for compileStrategy and verifyAudit, while live HTTP execution, OAuth 2.0 proxy tokens, and multi-tenant quotas remain disabled until Track 34 governance binds tenant, region, scope, concurrency, and approval policies.

findings.description: Canonical domain separation in release_message prefixes every field with big-endian 64-bit length tags, preventing ambiguity, delimiter collision, and signature transposition attacks.
findings.recommendation: Preserve length-prefixed domain-separated serialization for all future cryptographic release envelopes.

findings.description: Cryptographic key revocation in verify_signed_component_release actively verifies policy revocations against the evaluation timestamp, failing closed with PluginError::RevokedKey for any revoked key.
findings.recommendation: Maintain fail-closed revocation checks in future remote trust policy distribution mechanisms.

findings.description: The OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification defines candidate schemas for compileStrategy and verifyAudit while preserving the strict remote boundary that denies unauthenticated remote execution without Track 34 governance.
findings.recommendation: Enforce explicit Track 34 dependency gating before exposing any live HTTP listener or remote proxy authentication.

assertions_evaluated.notes: Ed25519 signature verification, domain-separated release messages, and fail-closed key revocation audited and verified with 100% pass rate in component_sandbox_scenarios.rs.
Large-corpus StudyGraph contracts and FileReviewStore verified; scalable DuckDB/Parquet execution engine claims properly bounded.

OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification validated in test_wasi_http_scale_governance.py; remote unauthenticated HTTP execution, OAuth proxy tokens, and multi-tenant quotas strictly denied pending Track 34 governance.

calibration_notes: Security and governance auditors confirm that cryptographic verification, domain separation, key revocation, and remote execution boundary controls are rigorously enforced. Remote unauthenticated execution is strictly prevented.
claim_boundary: Source-verified implementation only. Local Ed25519 signature admission, domain separation, and key revocation are verified; publisher identity infrastructure, registry distribution, and remote authenticated execution remain gated under Track 34.
